messages:
Maya: Quick sync: Marketing planning a public post for Optimize v0.9 on Wed @09:00 PT. We need the final changelog URL, the docs landing (with tracking param), and one p95 latency stat + token-cost delta by EOD Tue. Who can own?
Sanjay: I can own the changelog permalink. PR is merged but I'll wait to publish until docs URL is live. Current ref: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412
Liam: Docs will publish the Optimize guide today. Targeting Tue 14:00 PT for canonical URL. We'll add ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 before handing it off.
Olivia: Rollout plan: canary in us-west at 09:00 PT, 30m observation window, then ramp. Canary will be reachable publicly but capacity-limited. If press needs the GA endpoint at 09:00 we can keep the canary open.
Maya: Important: marketing wants screenshots to match live behavior. Will the canary run the same UX/flags?
Olivia: Yes, same code path and no feature gating for the user flow.
Samir: I'll capture a p95 snapshot and export a 7-day baseline vs v0.9 CSV immediately after canary start and post them here for design (aiming for Tue 15:00).
Priya: Webinar is Thu 10:00 PT. Landing page needs the short blurb and a CTA that funnels leads to SDR queue 'inbound-launch-Optimize'. Can eng include a tag and campaign in the webhook so we can route?
Sanjay: We'll add "campaign":"optimize_v0.9" and "tag":"optimize-launch" to the webhook payload. Example payload will match SDR's rule exactly.
Priya: Example payload for SDR routing (must match):
```
{
  "source": "web-forms",
  "campaign": "optimize_v0.9",
  "tag": "optimize-launch",
  "route_to": "sdr-inbound/optimize"
}
```
Sanjay: Confirmed. We'll include the fields verbatim and coordinate schema bump with release-bot.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: service/optimize v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00, full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI: all checks passed.
Maya: Deliverables from eng/docs: 1) changelog permalink, 2) docs URL with ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9, 3) one-sentence product blurb (2 sentences max) for socials, 4) p95 screenshot + CSV. We plan to schedule the announce at Wed 09:05 PT (tweet + blog link).
Samir: I'll attach the p95 dashboard screenshot and CSV by Tue 15:00.
Liam: Docs URL will be live by Tue 14:00: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v0.9 (will hand over with utm param appended).
Maya: Once links are posted here, I'll finalize blog + social copy and send to design. Also need the exact short blurb for the tweet — two sentences max.
Olivia: Eng will monitor canary telemetry. If p95 exceeds threshold we'll hold the ramp and notify this channel immediately. Rollback plan ready.
Priya: SDR play: tag inbound leads as "optimize-launch" and priority P2. I'll verify routing when the first webhook arrives.
Maya: No other blockers. Please post final links and the 2-sentence blurb in this thread when available. Thanks! :rocket:
